features.name: motion
features.description: Bounded adult-requested wheel movements with an Arduino watchdog.

features.name: vision
features.description: Local person, face and object recognition from the current camera frame.

features.name: speech
features.description: Local microphone transcription and Piper speech output.

features.name: memory
features.description: Persistent people, facts and reminders stored locally in SQLite.

features.name: emotions
features.description: Bounded happiness, curiosity, loneliness and concern signals controlling expression and style.

features.name: dashboard
features.description: Adult-only local web chat, diagnostics, vision, audio, Wi-Fi and memory interface.

features.name: learning
features.description: Persistent bounded calibration from explicit feedback; factory safety limits always win.

features.name: observations
features.description: Timestamped labels for people and objects B2 has seen; camera images are not retained.

features.name: dynamic display
features.description: Python services can send validated custom 8x8 monochrome frames to the Arduino.

features.name: web search
features.description: Optional SearXNG web search using the common skill entrypoint; available only when configured.
